summary: Birks Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held September 17, 2026, in Montreal. Shareholders of record as of July 24, 2026 elected five directors—Niccol Rossi di Montelera, Davide Barberis Canonico, M. Eugenia Girón, Deborah Shannon Trudeau and Paola Farnesi—each receiving over 83.3 million votes for, with minimal opposition, and ratified Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton LLP as auditors, authorizing directors to fix remuneration. The filing discloses no transaction, no price or stake terms, and no advisor engagement, constituting a routine meeting-results disclosure rather than a special situation.
